slides.title: Electrical contractor calmly defending my unreasonable opinions:
slides.body: deadpan. no notes. I will not be taking questions.

slides.label: Opinion #1
slides.title: Renewing the electrical license 60 days early is not "too early."

slides.label: Opinion #2
slides.title: If the COI on file is from last year, it's not a COI.

slides.label: Opinion #3
slides.title: A sticky note on the truck dash is not a filing system.

slides.label: Opinion #4
slides.title: "I think the bond renews in spring" is not a date.

slides.label: Opinion #5
slides.title: The journeyman cards belong on a calendar, not in the foreman's head.
slides.body: He's great. He's also on vacation.

slides.title: I'm not being dramatic. I'm being renewed.
slides.body: Which one would you defend in front of the whole crew?
